description: Use this when someone asks which mahadasha or antardasha they are running, their Vimshottari dasha timeline, when their next dasha begins, or when a dasha ends ("when does my Rahu dasha end", "my current dasha lord", "which dasha was I in during 2019", "when is my Venus antardasha"). Returns every mahadasha with dates, and the antardasha, pratyantar and sookshma running now. Set on_date for what was or will be running on another day; set mahadasha to list all nine antardashas of one mahadasha with dates. For what a dasha means in general, without birth details, use mahadasha_meaning. Needs birth date, time and town.

birth_place.description: Town or city of birth, with region or country if known, e.g. "Chicago, Illinois, US" or "Pune, India".

birth_time.description: Local clock time of birth, 24-hour HH:MM, e.g. 13:35. As exact as possible (from a birth certificate).

mahadasha.description: Optional: one mahadasha lord, to list all nine antardashas of that mahadasha with dates, past, now or ahead.

on_date.description: Optional: a day as YYYY-MM-DD, to see which periods were or will be running then. Leave out for today.

name: current_dasha
title: Current dasha (Vimshottari)
